reviews.title: Expérience extrêmement décevant avec badoo
reviews.text:
Expérience extrêmement décevante avec Badoo.

J’ai créé mon compte et souscrit un abonnement Premium de 3 mois à 29,99 €. Moins de deux heures après mon inscription, mon compte a été suspendu sans que je comprenne pourquoi.

J’ai contacté le service client pour obtenir des explications. Leur seule réponse a été que j’avais enfreint leur charte, sans me préciser quelle règle j’aurais violée. Ils m’ont également indiqué que leur décision était définitive.

Résultat : 29,99 € dépensés pour un service dont je n’ai pratiquement pas pu profiter. J’ai dû demander un remboursement auprès d’Apple.

Je respecte leur droit de modérer leur plateforme, mais je trouve inadmissible de laisser un client payer un abonnement avant de lui retirer presque immédiatement l’accès, sans explication précise.

Je déconseille cette application au vu de mon expérience. Faites attention avant de souscrire un abonnement payant.

reviews.title: Expensive subscription, misleading location filters
reviews.text:
I have been using Badoo for months and paid for the subscription, but it feels almost useless. The subscription is expensive, and I don’t see real value from it.
My main issue is the location system. I set my filters to find people near me because I’m looking for someone local — someone I can actually meet for coffee, talk to in person, and build a real connection with. But many profiles are shown as if they are 10, 30, or 50 miles away, and after chatting they admit they are actually in completely different countries.
This is extremely misleading. I’m not looking for long-distance texting with people in another part of the world. I’m paying for a dating app to meet real local people, but instead I keep getting matches that look suspicious, have inaccurate locations, or feel like fake profiles.
Badoo needs to fix location verification and stop showing international profiles as local matches. Right now, the paid experience feels unreliable and misleading.

reviews.title: Point à améliorer selon moi
reviews.text:
Vérification obligatoire des profils : *rendre la vérification plus systématique pour limiter les faux comptes, les arnaques et les usurpations d’identité. Cela renforcerait la confiance des utilisateurs.
* Période d’essai Premium : permettre aux nouveaux utilisateurs, notamment aux femmes, de tester gratuitement certaines fonctionnalités Premium pendant une ou deux semaines avant de devoir souscrire un abonnement.
* Filtres plus précis sur les préférences : offrir davantage d’options pour filtrer les profils selon les critères qui comptent pour chaque utilisateur (religion, origine culturelle, langue, centres d’intérêt, projet de vie, etc.). Cela permettrait de voir plus rapidement des profils compatibles avec ses attentes.
* Meilleure personnalisation du fil de profils : l’algorithme pourrait davantage tenir compte des préférences indiquées par les utilisateurs afin de proposer des profils correspondant mieux à leurs critères et éviter de présenter des personnes avec lesquelles il y a peu de chances de compatibilité.

reviews.title: Avoid this Cash Grab
reviews.text:
I went into this with high hopes, and vast experience in dating apps dating back to the early days of the internet. It looks great, has an understandable interface, but after paying $59 for 3 months of their “premium” membership, imagine my dismay when I’m suddenly faced with pop ups of offers to “purchase credits”, just to send messages! 
   Also, it seems there are certain individuals, that I highly suspect are more than likely AI or hired “agents” anyway. Probably hired to populate the site and make it appear there are many female members when in all reality, there are hardly any legitimate locals. The only one I encountered was living out of her car and knew hardly any English.    
   The site also invites those from other countries who are more than likely looking to defraud male members. Those were the majority of contacts and matches that flooded my notifications. Ghana,Nigeria, Kenya, Morocco, and Korea. You name it. 
   In conclusion, the site is nothing more than an overpriced polished cash grab, not worthy of a single man’s membership.

reviews.title: AVOID!!
reviews.text:
I thought I had cancelled, but noticed my card had been charged. I contacted customer support the same day and was told this purchase was non-refundable, despite me explaining I was under the impression it was already cancelled and mentioning my living situation. It’s clear they only care about making money and not the impact they make on people, or genuine customer experiences. 
I’ve completely lost trust in this company and if anyone else is in the same boat as me then maybe do what I’m thinking of doing- initiate a SAR, I’m not convinced my data is being handled appropriately so if other people have the same concern then that’s something you can do. Also make sure you double check you have cancelled- apps do have bugs and this company won’t take your word for it that you cancelled, so film yourself going through the act of cancelling so that you have the proof that you tried to cancel when you say you did. 
Oh and the whole reason of signing up in the first place- it’s not even a great app to use… others like Hinge, Bumble, Tinder are much better than this one. You’ll have much better luck there.
